title: 80 Years Old, 4th Term: Lula Wins Brazil #Shorts
description: Can 80 be the start of a new term? Brazil's voters just said yes. Lula finished second in the first round on 4 October, then won the 25 October runoff against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with about 51.8% of the vote. It is the first time since 1989 that a first-round runner-up has won a Brazilian runoff. He turns 81 on 27 October and starts his fourth term on 5 January 2027, and India chairs BRICS this year. Subscribe for the day's news explained in a minute. Sources: NPR, CNBC, Brazil's TSE. Made by AI. Made with hope. Footage: stock clips for illustration (Pixabay, NASA), not of the actual event. #Shorts #NewsExplained #WorldNews #IndiaNews #Explained
